name: Promo offer
description: A flash-sale or promotion screen: big headline, the offer, the price with the old price struck through and the saving worked out for you, and a live "ends in" countdown that switches to an "offer ended" message by itself. Add a product picture and a QR code to your shop page. Three looks: bold retail, clean minimal and warm café. Nothing is fetched.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: eyebrow
params.label: Small heading
params.help: A short label above the headline. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: offer
params.label: Offer line
params.default: Active noise cancelling and a 40-hour battery, at our lowest price this year.
params.help: One or two lines under the headline. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: price
params.label: Price
params.help: A number like 89 or 89.99 is formatted in your currency. Anything else ("2 for 1") is shown as typed. Leave empty to hide the price.

params.name: was_price
params.label: Was price
params.help: Optional. Shown struck through beside the price.

params.name: currency
params.label: Currency code
params.help: A three-letter ISO code: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, AUD… The symbol and its position follow the language. Leave empty for bare numbers.

options.label: Only when the price has cents (89, 89.50)

params.name: saving
params.label: Saving badge
params.help: Worked out from the price and the was price; hidden when either is not a number.

params.name: saving_text
params.label: Saving badge wording
params.help: {saving} is replaced by the percentage or amount, e.g. "{saving} off". Empty: "Save {saving}" in the screen's language. A single - shows the saving alone.

params.name: ends_at
params.label: Offer ends
params.help: Date and time like 2026-11-29T23:59, or a date alone for the end of that day. Read in the timezone below. Empty: the offer ends at midnight every day.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Timezone
params.help: The timezone the end time is in. Empty uses the screen's clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: The language of the built-in words, dates, prices and countdown units. Empty uses the screen's language.

params.name: countdown_label
params.label: Countdown label
params.help: Empty: "Ends in" in the screen's language. A single - hides the label.

params.name: show_end_date
params.label: Show when the offer ends
params.help: A line like "Offer ends Sun 29 Nov, 23:59" under the countdown.

params.name: end_date_label
params.label: End date wording
params.help: Put before the date. Empty: "Offer ends …" in the screen's language. A single - shows the date alone.

options.label: Keep the promo and show the ended message
Replace the whole promo with the fallback line

params.name: ended_text
params.label: Ended message
params.help: Empty: "This offer has ended" in the screen's language.

params.name: fallback_heading
params.label: Fallback heading
params.help: A small line above the fallback line. Empty shows the fallback line on its own.

params.name: fallback_text
params.label: Fallback line
params.default: New deals every Friday. See you then!
params.help: Shown full screen after the end when the setting above says so. Empty uses the ended message.

params.name: image
params.label: Product image
params.help: A PNG with a transparent background works best. Leave empty for a text-only promo.

params.name: qr_url
params.label: QR code link
params.help: Drawn as a QR code on the screen. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: qr_label
params.label: QR code caption
params.help: Empty: "Scan to shop" in the screen's language. A single - hides the caption.

params.name: fine_print
params.label: Fine print
params.default: While stocks last. Limit two per customer. Not valid with any other offer. Prices include sales tax.

params.name: custom_colors
params.label: Use my own colours
params.help: Off: the style's own palette. On: the three colours below.

params.name: accent
params.label: Accent colour
params.help: The price, the badge and the countdown.
